description: This file defines a mock class for the SecureStorageService gRPC service, using Google Mock for testing purposes. It declares mock methods corresponding to the service's RPCs such as GetValue, UpdateValue, DeleteValue, DeleteAllValues, and SeedValue, and includes relevant protobuf header dependencies.

classes.name: SecureStorageServiceMock
classes.description: A mock class for the SecureStorageService gRPC service, providing mock implementations for service RPC methods for testing purposes.

methods.name: ~SecureStorageServiceMock
methods.description: Default destructor for the mock class.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Mock method for the GetValue RPC, retrieving a value from secure storage.

methods.name: UpdateValue
methods.description: Mock method for the UpdateValue RPC, updating a value in secure storage.

methods.name: DeleteValue
methods.description: Mock method for the DeleteValue RPC, deleting a specific value.

methods.name: DeleteAllValues
methods.description: Mock method for the DeleteAllValues RPC, deleting all stored values.

methods.name: SeedValue
methods.description: Mock method for the SeedValue RPC, prepopulating secure storage with data.
